C1.ielts_writing: Prices spiraled out of control.
C1.mistake: "downward spiral" bedeutet "Abwärtsspirale"; Verb "spiral".

C1.def: happening at irregular intervals
C1.example: Sporadic gunfire was heard.
C1.ielts_writing: Sporadic showers fell.
C1.mistake: Adverb "sporadically"; Betonung auf der zweiten Silbe.

C1.def: a strong light, or public attention
C1.example: The actor stepped into the spotlight.
C1.ielts_writing: The scandal put the spotlight on the firm.
C1.mistake: Idiom: "steal the spotlight" bedeutet "die Show stehlen".

C1.def: an area of wet land with plants

C1.def: representing an idea

C1.def: a group of signs that occur together

C1.def: the combining of parts into a whole

C1.def: a thick sweet liquid

C1.def: to postpone a discussion

C1.def: a ship or truck that carries liquid

C1.def: a small pie with a sweet filling

C1.def: a device for sending messages by wire

C1.def: an information service shown on television

C1.def: to broadcast on television

C1.def: a person who rents property

C1.def: an area of land and its natural features

C1.def: extremely good, or very great

C1.def: to give evidence in court

C1.def: a formal statement given in court

C1.def: relating to theater, or exaggerated

C1.def: to grow strongly and be successful

C1.def: a short pin with a flat head

C1.def: to be better than, or to put on top
C1.example: Her score topped everyone.
C1.ielts_writing: They topped the cake with cream.
C1.mistake: Phrasal verb: "top off" bedeutet "abrunden"; "top the list" bedeutet "ganz oben stehen".

C1.def: of the highest quality
C1.example: The hotel offers topnotch service.
C1.ielts_writing: She hired a topnotch lawyer.
C1.mistake: Auch "top-notch" mit Bindestrich.

C1.def: a strong fast stream of liquid, or a flood of things
C1.example: A torrent of water washed the road.
C1.ielts_writing: He received a torrent of abuse.
C1.mistake: Adjektiv "torrential"; Betonung auf der ersten Silbe.

C1.def: the main part of the body without head and limbs
C1.example: The torso was found first.
C1.ielts_writing: A statue of a male torso stood nearby.
C1.mistake: Plural "torsos"; bei Statuen: "Torso".

C1.def: severe pain inflicted to punish or force someone
C1.example: Torture is banned by law.
C1.ielts_writing: Prisoners were tortured.
C1.mistake: Person "torturer"; bildlich "It's torture" bedeutet "Es ist eine Qual".

C1.def: to throw lightly or carelessly
C1.example: He tossed the keys onto the table.
C1.ielts_writing: They toss a coin to decide.
C1.mistake: Idiom: "toss and turn" bedeutet "sich im Bett hin und her wälzen".

C1.def: to add up to a number
C1.example: The bill totaled fifty dollars.
C1.ielts_writing: Costs totaled two million.
C1.mistake: Verb "total" (US: totaled); Nomen "total" (Gesamtsumme).

C1.def: effects that tourism has on places
C1.example: Tourism impacts local communities.
C1.ielts_writing: Researchers study tourism impacts on coasts.
C1.mistake: Plural "impacts"; Singular "tourism impact".

C1.def: the cheapest class of travel
C1.example: We flew tourist class.
C1.ielts_writing: A tourist class ticket is cheap.
C1.mistake: Heute meist "economy class"; Gegenteil: "first class".

C1.def: full of tourists and made for them
C1.example: The square is touristy.
C1.ielts_writing: A touristy restaurant overcharged us.
C1.mistake: Oft abwertend; Gegenteil: "authentic".

C1.def: poisonous or harmful
C1.example: The fumes are toxic.
C1.ielts_writing: A toxic workplace drains staff.
C1.mistake: Nomen "toxin"; bildlich "toxic" bedeutet "schädlich".

C1.def: a small sign that something existed
C1.example: Police found no trace of him.
C1.ielts_writing: Researchers traced the source.
C1.mistake: Konstruktion: "trace sth BACK TO sth"; Adjektiv "traceable".

C1.def: the buying and selling of goods
C1.example: Trade between nations grew.
C1.ielts_writing: He trades stocks.
C1.mistake: Person "trader"; Konstruktion: "trade IN sth".

C1.def: a name or symbol legally registered for a product
C1.example: The company owns the trademark.
C1.ielts_writing: Her laugh is her trademark.
C1.mistake: Plural "trademarks"; auch bildlich: Erkennungszeichen.

C1.def: a skilled worker or a shopkeeper
C1.example: A tradesman fixed the roof.
C1.ielts_writing: The tradesman arrived on time.
C1.mistake: Plural "tradesmen"; neutrale Form: "tradesperson".

C1.def: illegal trade in people or drugs
C1.example: Drug trafficking is a crime.
C1.ielts_writing: Human trafficking harms victims.
C1.mistake: Verb "traffic IN sth" (handeln mit); Person "trafficker".

C1.def: causing great sadness
C1.example: It was a tragic accident.
C1.ielts_writing: The tragic story moved her.
C1.mistake: Nomen "tragedy"; Adverb "tragically".

C1.def: a path through the countryside, or a mark left behind
C1.example: We followed a forest trail.
C1.ielts_writing: The comet trailed light.
C1.mistake: Idiom: "blaze a trail" bedeutet "Bahnbrecher sein"; "trail BY" beim Spiel.

C1.def: a vehicle pulled behind another, or a film advertisement
C1.example: They towed a trailer.
C1.ielts_writing: The movie trailer was thrilling.
C1.mistake: Zwei Bedeutungen: Fahrzeug und Filmvorschau; Plural "trailers".

C1.def: an electric vehicle running on rails in a city
C1.example: We took the tram downtown.
C1.ielts_writing: The tram runs every ten minutes.
C1.mistake: Plural "trams"; Synonym "streetcar".

C1.def: identifying with a gender different from that assigned at birth
C1.example: She is a trans woman.
C1.ielts_writing: Trans people deserve respect.
C1.mistake: Kurzform von "transgender"; Gegenteil: "cis".

C1.def: an act of buying or selling
C1.example: The transaction was approved.
C1.ielts_writing: Each transaction is recorded.
C1.mistake: Verb "transact"; Plural "transactions".

C1.def: a written copy of spoken words or records
C1.example: Request a transcript of the meeting.
C1.ielts_writing: A transcript of the trial was published.
C1.mistake: Verb "transcribe"; Betonung auf der ersten Silbe.

C1.def: a complete change in form or nature
C1.example: The city underwent a transformation.
C1.ielts_writing: Digital transformation reshapes business.
C1.mistake: Verb "transform"; Betonung auf der dritten Silbe.

C1.def: having a gender identity different from that assigned at birth
C1.example: He is a transgender man.
C1.ielts_writing: Transgender rights remain debated.
C1.mistake: Nicht "transsexuell"; als Adjektiv, nicht als Nomen verwenden.

C1.def: lasting only a short time
C1.example: The pain was transient.
C1.ielts_writing: They lived a transient life.
C1.mistake: Nomen "transience"; Gegenteil: "permanent".

C1.def: the movement of people or goods
C1.example: Public transit is cheap.
C1.ielts_writing: The goods were damaged in transit.
C1.mistake: "in transit" bedeutet "unterwegs"; Nomen unzählbar.

C1.def: a verb that needs an object
C1.example: "Give" is a transitive verb.
C1.ielts_writing: A transitive verb takes a direct object.
collocations: direct object of a transitive verb
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "intransitive verb"; Abkürzung "vt".

C1.def: the sending of signals or disease, or a vehicle gear system
C1.example: The transmission of the virus slowed.
C1.ielts_writing: The car needs a new transmission.
C1.mistake: Verb "transmit"; Betonung auf der zweiten Silbe.

C1.def: openness in how things are done
C1.example: Voters demand transparency.
C1.ielts_writing: The company promised transparency in its accounts.
C1.mistake: Adjektiv "transparent"; Gegenteil: "secrecy".

C1.def: easy to see through, or openly honest
C1.example: The glass is transparent.
C1.ielts_writing: The process must be transparent.
C1.mistake: Nomen "transparency"; Gegenteil: "opaque".

C1.def: a severe shock or injury
C1.example: The accident left her with trauma.
C1.ielts_writing: Childhood trauma can last.
C1.mistake: Adjektiv "traumatic"; Plural "traumas".

C1.def: a formal written work on a subject
C1.example: He wrote a treatise on law.
C1.ielts_writing: The philosopher published a treatise.
C1.mistake: Konstruktion: "treatise ON sth"; nicht "treaty" (Vertrag).

C1.def: a formal agreement between countries
C1.example: The countries signed a treaty.
C1.ielts_writing: The treaty ended the war.
C1.mistake: Nicht "treatise" (Abhandlung); Plural "treaties".

C1.def: very great or very good
C1.example: She faced tremendous pressure.
C1.ielts_writing: It was a tremendous success.
C1.mistake: Adverb "tremendously"; Betonung auf der zweiten Silbe.

C1.def: a long narrow ditch
C1.example: Soldiers dug a trench.
C1.ielts_writing: A deep trench ran beside the road.
C1.mistake: "trench coat" ist der Trenchcoat; Plural "trenches".

C1.def: relating to a tribe
C1.example: The area has tribal customs.
C1.ielts_writing: Tribal leaders met yesterday.
C1.mistake: Nomen "tribe"; "tribalism" bedeutet Gruppenzugehörigkeit.

C1.def: a special court dealing with a specific kind of issue
C1.example: The tribunal ruled on the case.
C1.ielts_writing: A war crimes tribunal began.
C1.mistake: Plural "tribunals"; Betonung auf der zweiten Silbe.

C1.def: something said or done to show respect
C1.example: They paid tribute to him.
C1.ielts_writing: The concert was a tribute to the singer.
C1.mistake: Konstruktion: "pay tribute TO sb"; auch historisch "Tribut".

C1.def: something that causes a reaction
C1.example: The loud noise was a trigger.
C1.ielts_writing: The comment triggered an argument.
C1.mistake: "trigger warning" bedeutet "Inhaltshinweis"; Idiom: "pull the trigger".

C1.def: a series of three connected works
C1.example: The trilogy sold millions.
C1.ielts_writing: She finished reading the trilogy.
C1.ielts_speaking: "The final book of the trilogy is out."
C1.mistake: Plural "trilogies"; Betonung auf der ersten Silbe.

C1.def: a group of three people or things
C1.example: A jazz trio played downtown.
C1.ielts_writing: The trio won the prize.
C1.mistake: Plural "trios"; Konstruktion: "a trio OF sth".

C1.def: a great victory or success
C1.example: Winning was a triumph.
C1.ielts_writing: She returned in triumph.
C1.mistake: Adjektiv "triumphant"; Konstruktion: "triumph OVER sb/sth".

C1.def: of little value or importance
C1.example: It's a trivial matter.
C1.ielts_writing: Trivial details distracted him.
C1.mistake: Nomen "triviality"; "trivia" ist Wissenskram.

C1.def: a prize given for winning
C1.example: The team won the trophy.
C1.ielts_writing: A trophy stood on the shelf.
C1.mistake: "trophy wife" ist abwertend; Plural "trophies".

C1.def: worried or having problems
C1.example: He had a troubled childhood.
C1.ielts_writing: The troubled company closed.
C1.mistake: Nomen "trouble"; Idiom: "troubled waters" bedeutet "unruhige Zeiten".

C1.def: a student who stays away from school without permission
C1.example: The truant was caught.
C1.ielts_writing: Truants often miss class.
C1.mistake: Nomen "truancy"; "play truant" bedeutet "die Schule schwänzen".

C1.def: an agreement to stop fighting for a time
C1.example: They agreed to a truce.
C1.ielts_writing: A truce held for a week.
C1.mistake: Idiom: "call a truce" bedeutet "Waffenstillstand erklären".

C1.def: stories about real crimes
C1.example: She loves true crime.
C1.ielts_writing: True crime podcasts are popular.
C1.mistake: Genre; unzählbar.

C1.def: the back storage space of a car, or a tree's main stem
C1.example: Put the bags in the trunk.
C1.ielts_writing: The tree trunk was thick.
C1.mistake: Mehrere Bedeutungen: Kofferraum, Stamm, Rüssel, Truhe.

C1.def: a person who manages property for others
C1.example: The trustee managed the fund.
C1.ielts_writing: A school trustee voted yes.
C1.mistake: Nomen "trust"; Betonung auf der letzten Silbe.

C1.def: able to be relied on
C1.example: She is a trustworthy colleague.
C1.ielts_writing: Trustworthy sources are essential.
C1.mistake: Nomen "trustworthiness"; Gegenteil: "untrustworthy".

C1.def: telling the truth
C1.example: Give a truthful answer.
C1.ielts_writing: He is a truthful person.
C1.mistake: Nomen "truth"; Adverb "truthfully".

C1.def: money paid for teaching, or the teaching itself
C1.example: Tuition costs are rising.
C1.ielts_writing: She pays tuition each semester.
C1.mistake: Unzählbar; "tuition fees" sind Studiengebühren.

C1.def: a cold treeless region
C1.example: Reindeer cross the tundra.
C1.ielts_writing: The tundra stays frozen.
C1.mistake: Unzählbar; Aussprache mit /ʌ/.

C1.def: to watch or listen to a broadcast
C1.example: Tune in at eight.
C1.ielts_writing: Millions tuned in to the show.
C1.mistake: Konstruktion: "tune in TO sth"; auch bildlich "auf etwas eingestellt sein".

C1.def: without a pleasing tune
C1.example: He sang a tuneless song.
C1.ielts_writing: The tuneless humming annoyed her.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "tuneful"; Nomen "tune".

C1.def: a deep covered dish for serving soup
C1.example: She filled the tureen.
C1.ielts_writing: A soup tureen sat on the table.
C1.mistake: Plural "tureens"; Betonung auf der zweiten Silbe.

C1.def: a round white root vegetable
C1.example: She boiled a turnip.
C1.ielts_writing: Turnips grow in cold soil.
C1.mistake: Plural "turnips"; unterscheide von "beet".

C1.def: the number of people who attend or vote
C1.example: Voter turnout was high.
C1.ielts_writing: The turnout at the rally surprised us.
C1.mistake: Unzählbar; Konstruktion: "turnout AT an event".

C1.def: the amount of business done, or the rate staff leave
C1.example: The company's turnover rose.
C1.ielts_writing: Staff turnover is high.
C1.mistake: Zwei Bedeutungen: Umsatz und Mitarbeiterfluktuation.

C1.def: blue-green in color
C1.example: The sea was turquoise.
C1.ielts_writing: She wore turquoise earrings.
C1.mistake: Auch Nomen: Edelstein "turquoise".

C1.def: a long pointed tooth of an elephant
C1.example: The elephant has a long tusk.
C1.ielts_writing: Tusks are made of ivory.
C1.mistake: Plural "tusks"; bei Elefanten und Walrossen.

C1.def: a room with two single beds
C1.example: We booked a twin bedroom.
C1.ielts_writing: The twin bedroom has two beds.
C1.mistake: Plural "twin bedrooms"; Gegenteil: "single room".

C1.def: a sudden change in a story, or a turning movement
C1.example: The film has a surprise twist.
C1.ielts_writing: She twisted her ankle.
C1.mistake: Idiom: "twist someone's arm" bedeutet "jemanden überreden".

C1.def: appearing everywhere
C1.example: Phones are ubiquitous.
C1.ielts_writing: Ubiquitous advertising surrounds us.
C1.mistake: Nomen "ubiquity"; Betonung auf der zweiten Silbe.

C1.def: to remove something that blocks
C1.example: A plumber unblocked the drain.
C1.ielts_writing: Unblock the pipe quickly.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "block"; Partizip "unblocked".

C1.def: the state of not knowing what will happen
C1.example: Uncertainty surrounds the plan.
C1.ielts_writing: Economic uncertainty worries investors.
C1.mistake: Adjektiv "uncertain"; Plural "uncertainties".

C1.def: not having made a decision
C1.example: She is undecided about college.
C1.ielts_writing: Undecided voters will choose late.
C1.mistake: Konstruktion: "undecided ABOUT sth"; Nomen "decision".

C1.def: impossible to deny
C1.example: The evidence is undeniable.
C1.ielts_writing: It is an undeniable fact.
C1.mistake: Adverb "undeniably"; Verb "deny".

C1.def: feeling stress from demands
C1.example: She works well under pressure.
C1.ielts_writing: The team was under pressure to deliver.
C1.mistake: Konstruktion: "under pressure TO do sth".

C1.def: working secretly
C1.example: An undercover agent infiltrated the gang.
C1.ielts_writing: Undercover work is dangerous.
C1.mistake: Auch Adverb: "go undercover" bedeutet "verdeckt ermitteln".

C1.def: a person or team expected to lose
C1.example: The underdog won the match.
C1.ielts_writing: Everyone roots for the underdog.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "favorite"; Plural "underdogs".

C1.def: working less than one could or should
C1.example: Many graduates are underemployed.
C1.ielts_writing: Underemployed workers want more hours.
C1.mistake: Nomen "underemployment"; nicht "arbeitslos".

C1.def: to think something is smaller than it is
C1.example: Never underestimate her.
C1.ielts_writing: Experts underestimated the risk.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "overestimate"; Betonung auf der vierten Silbe.

C1.def: to be the basis of something
C1.example: Fear underlies his behavior.
C1.ielts_writing: Principles that underlie the theory remain valid.
C1.mistake: Unregelmäßig: underlie, underlay, underlain; Adjektiv "underlying".

C1.def: forming the basis of something
C1.example: We must find the underlying cause.
C1.ielts_writing: Underlying problems remain.
C1.mistake: Verb "underlie"; steht meist vor Nomen.

C1.def: to weaken gradually
C1.example: Rumors undermine trust.
C1.ielts_writing: Corruption undermines democracy.
C1.mistake: Idiom: "undermine sb's authority"; Betonung auf der dritten Silbe.

C1.def: to begin or agree to do something
C1.example: They undertook a major project.
C1.ielts_writing: She undertook to finish by Friday.
C1.mistake: Unregelmäßig: undertake, undertook, undertaken; Nomen "undertaking".

C1.def: not wanted or approved
C1.example: The drug has undesirable side effects.
C1.ielts_writing: Undesirable behavior was punished.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "desirable"; auch Nomen "undesirables".

C1.def: without any doubt
C1.example: She is undoubtedly the best.
C1.ielts_writing: This is undoubtedly a problem.
C1.mistake: Adjektiv "undoubted"; Satzadverb.

C1.def: worried or uncomfortable
C1.example: She felt uneasy about the deal.
C1.ielts_writing: An uneasy silence filled the room.
C1.mistake: Konstruktion: "uneasy ABOUT sth"; Nomen "unease".

C1.def: not following the rules of grammar
C1.example: The sentence is ungrammatical.
C1.ielts_writing: Ungrammatical forms appear in speech.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "grammatical"; Nomen "grammar".

C1.def: to bring together into one
C1.example: The leader sought to unify the country.
C1.ielts_writing: Common goals unify the team.
C1.mistake: Nomen "unification"; Gegenteil: "divide".

C1.def: never having happened before
C1.example: The crisis was unprecedented.
C1.ielts_writing: Unprecedented growth surprised experts.
C1.mistake: Nomen "precedent"; Betonung auf der zweiten Silbe.

C1.def: not able to be foreseen
C1.example: The weather is unpredictable.
C1.ielts_writing: He has an unpredictable temper.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "predictable"; Nomen "unpredictability".

C1.def: difficult to control
C1.example: The unruly crowd shouted.
C1.ielts_writing: An unruly child disrupted class.
C1.mistake: Bei Haaren: "widerspenstig"; Gegenteil: "orderly".

C1.def: not said or written openly
C1.example: The unstated goal was profit.
C1.ielts_writing: Unstated rules guide behavior.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "stated"; Synonym "unspoken".

C1.def: to show something new for the first time
C1.example: The firm will unveil a new phone.
C1.ielts_writing: They unveiled the statue.
C1.mistake: Wörtlich "den Schleier abnehmen"; Nomen "unveiling".

C1.def: facing a problem or opponent
C1.example: We are up against a tough rival.
C1.ielts_writing: They were up against strict deadlines.
C1.mistake: Idiom: "up against it" bedeutet "in der Klemme sein".

C1.def: going to happen soon
C1.example: The upcoming election matters.
C1.ielts_writing: We prepare for the upcoming launch.
C1.mistake: Steht vor Nomen; nicht nach "be".

C1.def: to improve to a higher quality
C1.example: We upgraded the software.
C1.ielts_writing: Request a seat upgrade.
C1.mistake: Betonung beim Nomen vorn ("UPgrade"), beim Verb hinten.

C1.def: a sudden big change or disturbance
C1.example: The city faced political upheaval.
C1.ielts_writing: Social upheaval followed the war.
C1.mistake: Betonung auf der zweiten Silbe; Plural selten.

C1.def: to support and keep in place
C1.example: The court upheld the ruling.
C1.ielts_writing: Judges uphold the law.
C1.mistake: Unregelmäßig: uphold, upheld, upheld; Gegenteil: "overturn".

C1.def: aimed at wealthy customers
C1.example: It is an upmarket hotel.
C1.ielts_writing: Upmarket shops line the street.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "downmarket"; Synonym "high-end".

C1.def: standing straight, or honest
C1.example: Sit upright in your chair.
C1.ielts_writing: He was an upright citizen.
C1.mistake: Auch Nomen "upright" (Klavier); "an upright man" ist moralisch gemeint.

C1.def: the good side of a situation
C1.example: The upside is lower cost.
C1.ielts_writing: There is an upside to waiting.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "downside"; "upside down" bedeutet "kopfüber".

C1.def: toward the source of a river
C1.example: We rowed upstream.
C1.ielts_writing: The fish swim upstream.
C1.mistake: Gegenteil: "downstream"; Idiom: "swim upstream".

C1.def: a standard way to connect devices
C1.example: Plug in the USB.
C1.ielts_writing: A USB cable charged the phone.
C1.mistake: Abkürzung "universal serial bus"; "USB stick" ist der Stick.

C1.def: usefulness, or a service such as water or power
C1.example: The tool has great utility.
C1.ielts_writing: Utility bills arrive monthly.
C1.mistake: Zwei Bedeutungen; "utilities" bedeutet Nebenkosten.

C1.def: to make practical use of
C1.example: We utilize new tools.
C1.ielts_writing: The firm utilizes solar power.
C1.mistake: Formeller als "use"; Nomen "utilization".

C1.def: completely
C1.example: He was utterly exhausted.
C1.ielts_writing: The plan was utterly useless.
C1.mistake: Adjektiv "utter"; verstärkt Adjektive.

C1.def: an unfilled job or room
C1.example: The firm has a vacancy.
C1.ielts_writing: There are no vacancies at the hotel.
C1.mistake: Schild "No vacancy" bedeutet "belegt"; Adjektiv "vacant".

C1.def: empty or not in use
C1.example: The seat is vacant.
C1.ielts_writing: A vacant lot sits next door.
C1.mistake: Nomen "vacancy"; "vacant stare" bedeutet "leerer Blick".

C1.def: to protect against disease with a vaccine
C1.example: Doctors vaccinate children.
C1.ielts_writing: They vaccinated the whole village.
C1.mistake: Nomen "vaccine"; Konstruktion: "vaccinate AGAINST a disease".

C1.def: a space with no air, or a cleaning machine
C1.example: Space is a vacuum.
C1.ielts_writing: She ran the vacuum.
C1.mistake: Verb "vacuum" (staubsaugen); "in a vacuum" bedeutet "isoliert".

C1.def: not clear or exact
C1.example: He gave a vague answer.
C1.ielts_writing: I have a vague memory of it.
C1.mistake: Adverb "vaguely"; Gegenteil: "specific".

C1.def: too proud of oneself, or useless
C1.example: She is vain about her looks.
C1.ielts_writing: They made a vain attempt.
C1.mistake: Idiom: "in vain" bedeutet "vergeblich"; Nomen "vanity".

C1.def: the importance or worth of something
C1.example: The painting has great value.
C1.ielts_writing: We value your feedback.
C1.mistake: Adjektiv "valuable"; "value for money" bedeutet "gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis".

C1.def: to deliberately damage property
C1.example: Youths vandalized the bus stop.
C1.ielts_writing: Someone vandalized the statue.
C1.mistake: Nomen "vandalism"; Person "vandal".

C1.def: a sweet flavoring from a plant
C1.example: Add vanilla to the batter.
C1.ielts_writing: Vanilla ice cream melted.
C1.ielts_speaking: "The scent of vanilla filled the kitchen."
C1.mistake: Adjektiv "vanilla" bedeutet auch "gewöhnlich".

C1.def: to disappear suddenly
C1.example: The magician made the coin vanish.
C1.ielts_writing: Hope began to vanish.
C1.mistake: Idiom: "vanish into thin air" bedeutet "spurlos verschwinden".

C1.def: gas formed from a liquid
C1.example: Vapor rose from the pot.
C1.ielts_writing: Water vapor condenses on glass.
C1.mistake: Verb "vaporize"; unzählbar.

C1.def: a factor that can change
C1.example: Temperature is a variable.
C1.ielts_writing: The weather is variable.
C1.mistake: Verb "vary"; Gegenteil: "constant".

C1.def: having many different kinds
C1.example: She leads a varied life.
C1.ielts_writing: A varied diet is healthy.
C1.mistake: Verb "vary"; Nomen "variety".

C1.def: many different kinds
C1.example: The shop sells a variety of goods.
C1.ielts_writing: Variety is the spice of life.
C1.mistake: Konstruktion: "a variety OF + Plural"; Betonung auf der zweiten Silbe.

C1.def: a person who eats no animal products
C1.example: She is a vegan.
C1.ielts_writing: A vegan meal contains no dairy.
